name: Dev Stats
author: qempexe
description: Contribution activity grid for GitHub, GitLab and Forgejo/Gitea/Codeberg in the Omarchy bar, using your existing gh/glab/tea/fj terminal logins.

barWidget.description: Contribution grid for GitHub, GitLab and Forgejo

schema.label: Show platform icon
schema.description: The GitHub, GitLab or Forgejo logo before the squares.

schema.label: Days on the bar
schema.description: How many recent days show as squares.

schema.label: Left click
schema.description: What a left click on the widget does. Right click always opens the settings.

schema.label: Middle click
schema.description: What a middle click on the widget does.

schema.label: Refresh automatically
schema.description: Fetch new numbers in the background. Off means only when you ask.

schema.label: Refresh every
schema.description: Minutes between updates. Each one runs your own gh, glab or curl.

schema.label: Grid color
schema.description: Color of the busiest days. Quieter days are darker shades of it.

schema.label: Settings panel colors
schema.description: Colors of this panel. Follow theme brings in your theme's accent.

schema.label: Panel accent color
schema.description: Pick one, or type a hex like #7aa2f7.
